content: Vulkan pipeline state (topology/cull-mode/front-face/depth-test) can be baked at VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo creation time (VkPipelineInputAssemblyStateCreateInfo.topology, VkPipelineRasterizationStateCreateInfo.cullMode/frontFace, VkPipelineDepthStencilStateCreateInfo.depthTestEnable) OR made dynamic via VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_CULL_MODE / VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_FRONT_FACE / VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY / VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_DEPTH_TEST_ENABLE plus vkCmdSetCullMode/vkCmdSetFrontFace/vkCmdSetPrimitiveTopology/vkCmdSetDepthTestEnable before drawing. Dynamic state usage for CULL_MODE/FRONT_FACE/PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY/DEPTH_TEST_ENABLE requires either VK_EXT_extended_dynamic_state (or the extendedDynamicState feature) or Vulkan 1.3 core -- NOT guaranteed on a baseline Vulkan 1.0/1.1 headless context. Given D-22's fresh-build-per-job policy (no pipeline caching/reuse across jobs), baking pipeline state into VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo directly (rebuilding the whole pipeline per job, no dynamic-state extension dependency) is simpler and has no downside since pipelines aren't reused anyway.
